parse_flake8_error_from_line: parse a flake8 error line into a Flake8Error dataclass using the from_line class method
format_flake8_output_basic: format raw flake8 output into a clean bulleted list of error messages without line numbers
format_flake8_output_with_line_numbers: format flake8 output with line and column numbers for each error in the output
filter_flake8_previous_errors: filter out previous flake8 errors from new output using an edit window and replacement line count
run_flake8_split_cli: run the flake8 output splitter CLI tool with flake8 output and optional previous errors and edit window
